ready2_open_rewrite.resolved_question_text: Which region in the diagram represents the labium minora?
ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: This image is a sagittal anatomical diagram of the female pelvis; the lower right is the external genital region near the vulva/vaginal opening, where leader lines labeled K, M, D, etc. point to adjacent structures. The leader line of M points to a smaller medial fold near the vaginal vestibule, located on the inner side of the larger lateral tissue. Reasoning: labium minora refers to the labia minora, the smaller, more medial lip-like folds in the vulva; the region indicated by M in the image matches this position and shape. Therefore the answer is M.
